text_block_list.text:
She said she wanted to go to a shrine, so 
I went with Daiwa Scarlet, and she 
immediately began praying with utmost 
sincerity.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...All right, that should do it. I hope it 
helps, even a little...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
My body's been feeling so heavy lately. 
I've tried all sorts of things, but 
nothing seems to help.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
They say this place brings good health and 
protects from illness, so I thought it 
might at least give you some peace of 
mind.
choice_data_list: Then I'll go say a prayer too.
Then I'll go make a prayer too!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: My, isn't that an admirable attitude.

I prayed from the bottom of my heart for 
Daiwa Scarlet to feel better.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, you look awfully serious... Well, I 
am your trainee, so I guess that's 
natural..."
choice_data_list: So, did you receive any divine favor?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, don't be silly. There's no way you'd 
see results that quickly.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Still... yeah. I feel like it might be... 
a little bit better?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's probably just some sort of 
placebo effect. Still, I'd like to do a 
light run first to check my condition.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's head back quickly! While 
I'm in top shape, I want to get plenty of 
running in!

It seems the blessing worked, and Daiwa 
Scarlet was in high spirits.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well, with moderate expectations in mind, 
I suppose I'll head back and get some 
training in for today—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Jeez, who is it now at a time like this?! 
And just when I was in a pretty decent 
mood, too!

It seemed Daiwa Scarlet wasn't able to 
receive the blessing...
